headline: Google's November Pixel Drop updates HiLight and dictation features
summary: Google's November 2026 Pixel Drop adds Google Messages support to the Pixel 11 Pro's HiLight light and brings its Rambler dictation technology to older Pixel 10 devices.

claims.statement: The Pixel 11 Pro's HiLight light now activates for Google Messages texts from favorite contacts.

sources.quote: Google is making Pixel HiLight slightly more useful

Google is adding a new feature to its underwhelming HiLight light on the back of Pixel 11 Pro phones: as part of the November 2026 Pixel Drop, the light can light up when you get Google Messages texts from your favorite contacts.
while the Pixel 11's HiLight feature now works with Google Messages.

claims.statement: The same Pixel Drop brings Google's Rambler dictation technology to older Pixel 10 devices.

sources.quote: Google's impressive Rambler dictation tech is now available on Pixel 10 devices too
November's Pixel Drop also brings other AI features to older Pixel phones
